title: Grounded Skill Synthesis from Code at Scale for Agentic Intelligence
task: Automated skill synthesis from source code for agent learning
key_results: CodeSkillBank produces 1,006,822 grounded skill records; models augmented with retrieved skills improve 11.7% on average across 72 evaluations; outperforms trajectory-derived skill banks on all 7 shared benchmarks
comments: Clever approach converting GitHub code into verifiable agent skills without requiring agent interaction, though generalization beyond software tasks unclear.

outputs: grounded skill records with workflow, boundary, provenance metadata

hypotheses.hypothesis: Repository-derived skills provide useful procedural knowledge before agents accumulate interaction experience
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: CodeSkillBank outperforms trajectory-derived banks on 7/7 shared benchmarks

hypotheses.hypothesis: AI-generated code can produce valid skills at quality parity with human code
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: AI-generated skills 93.50% pass rate vs 93.00% for human-written

title: CodeMidas: Scaling Agentic Coding RL Environments from Code Itself
task: Scaling RL environments for coding agents from source code
key_results: CodeMidas produces 5,545 training tasks across 3,185 codebases; MiMo-V2.5 achieves +11.7% DeepSWE, +17% ProgramBench, +8.5% Terminal-Bench improvements; trajectory analysis shows increased codebase exploration and diverse self-verification
comments: Systematic pipeline for extracting executable RL tasks from diverse codebases, validated across multiple benchmarks, though task quality depends on agentic filtering stages.

outputs: executable RL environment tasks with tests and specifications

hypotheses.hypothesis: Source code alone suffices to construct diverse, reliable RL training tasks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 5,545 tasks extracted from code without issue/commit artifacts

hypotheses.hypothesis: Increasing high-quality training tasks improves diverse coding benchmarks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: ablations show task quantity drives improvements across benchmarks

title: EvoOntology: A Self-Evolving Ontology Layer for Data Agents
task: Self-evolving ontology layer for heterogeneous data agents
key_results: EvoOntology outperforms baselines on three data-agent benchmarks with four LLM backbones; bridges agent-data gap through runtime ontology interaction and self-evolution loop
comments: Novel approach to the agent-data gap via adaptive semantic layers, though scalability to massive heterogeneous corpora remains to be validated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Self-evolving ontology adapts better to agent behavior than static semantic layers
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: EvoOntology consistently outperforms static semantic layer baselines

title: RecreationWorld: Scalable and Verifiable Environments for Hybrid Computer-Use Agents
task: Hybrid computer-use agents with reproducible multi-platform environments
key_results: GPT-6 Astra achieves 58.1% overall on RecreationBench; passes all programmatic tests on only 2.8% of tasks; agents reproduce static interfaces more reliably than interactions/computed outputs
comments: Comprehensive benchmark covering 5 platforms with factor-grounded evaluation, but significant gap between interface reproduction and functional correctness suggests fundamental reasoning challenges.

outputs: agent trajectory with GUI actions and code implementations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reference-grounded rewards enable agents to learn transfer-capable behaviors
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: models trained on RecreationWorld trajectories improve on 5 out-of-distribution benchmarks

hypotheses.hypothesis: Static interface structure is easier to reproduce than behavioral interactions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: higher reliability on interface reproduction vs. interaction/output verification

title: IntBMoE: Integrating Block-Level Conditioning into Expert Composition for Full-Participation Mixture-of-Experts
task: Decoupling participation, execution, and materialization in Mixture-of-Experts
key_results: IntBMoE achieves consistent gains over sparse/dense MoE baselines on image classification; deployed in AMap recommendation system with 2.4% relative UVCTR gain serving hundreds of millions users under 60ms latency
comments: Principled decoupling of three independent quantities through block conditioning is elegant, and production deployment validates practical utility.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Block-level conditioning enables full participation while maintaining sparse execution
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: all three quantities independently controlled; consistent gains over baselines

title: OmniVChat: Synthesizing, Benchmarking, and Training for Native Audio-Visual Dialogue
task: Native audio-visual dialogue with omni models
key_results: OmniVChat-Bench evaluates basic dialogue abilities across 5 categories; training with OmniVChat-RL improves Qwen3-Omni performance on both synthetic and human-recorded benchmarks
comments: Practical focus on synthesized data for training/evaluation addresses real data scarcity, with RL reward design targeting correctness, efficiency and style.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Synthesized dialogues enable effective training that transfers to real-world dialogues
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: gains on OmniVChat-Bench transfer to OmniVChat-Bench-Human

title: Paint-Anything: Unified Any-Color Control for Image Generation and Editing
task: Unified any-color control for image generation and editing via hex values
key_results: Paint-Anything improves FLUX.2-4B by 85.3% on ACBench-T2I and 28.3% on ACBench-Edit; Paint-500K dataset constructs via object grounding and color labeling with pure-color anchors
comments: Clever dual-supervision strategy using both real-image labels and synthetic pure-color anchors stabilizes color fidelity training.

inputs: text prompt with hex color value
outputs: generated/edited image with target object color

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pure-color anchors at high-noise timesteps stabilize hex-color training without domain shift
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: combining real images with pure-color anchors improves fidelity significantly

title: OmniVBench: A Benchmark and Large-Scale Dataset for Omni Reference-to-Video Generation
task: Benchmark and dataset for omni reference-to-video generation
key_results: OmniVBench spans 7 task families with 18 fine-grained tasks; Omni-R2V Dataset contains 340K training samples from professional video; current models achieve <3% all-test-pass on RecreationBench equivalent
comments: Factor-grounded evaluation with 12,172 case-specific checklist items is rigorous; dataset addresses real R2V construction challenges at scale.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Factor-grounded evaluation reveals disentanglement and binding failures invisible to holistic metrics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: fine-grained checklist assessment surfaces limitations not reflected in aggregate scores

title: GraphSkillEvo: Evolutionary Optimization of Graph-Structured Agent Skills
task: Evolutionary optimization of graph-structured agent skills
key_results: GraphSkillEvo improves average accuracy by 4.01% on GPT-5.4-nano and 1.76% on GPT-5.4 over SkillOpt baseline across 5 benchmarks
comments: Graph-structured skill representation with population-based evolution is principled, though improvements are modest relative to baseline skill optimization.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Graph-structured skills enable more effective optimization than unstructured natural-language skills
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: GraphSkillEvo outperforms SkillOpt via structured mutation/crossover operations

title: MintAct: A Unified Visual Agent for Digital Environments
task: Unified visual agent for multi-domain digital environments
key_results: MintAct matches per-domain specialists across mobile/desktop/web at 2B-8B scales; achieves 48.9% on OSWorld-Verified; scales across hundreds of concurrent environment instances
comments: Unified architecture matching specialists is notable; asynchronous RL framework addresses scalability, though online RL stability under noisy feedback is a remaining challenge.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Unified architecture can match per-domain specialists through careful environment/data/training design
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: MintAct achieves state-of-the-art across heterogeneous UI tasks

title: When AI Reviews Train AI Reviewers: Scientific-Judgment Collapse and Mitigation
task: Mitigating scientific-judgment collapse in recursive AI peer review
key_results: Introducing synthetic reviews compresses rating distributions and reduces semantic diversity (judgment collapse); TrustReviewer with curated corpus + activation steering preserves diversity without retraining
comments: Important characterization of feedback loop failure in AI-assisted scientific evaluation; proposed mitigations are practical but their long-term efficacy in real review systems uncertain.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Model-generated reviews entering training corpora compress judgment distributions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: mixtures of synthetic reviews reduce rating and semantic diversity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Curated corpus + test-time activation steering mitigates collapse without retraining
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: TrustReviewer preserves diversity on ICLR 2024 test set

title: FRAUDSkill: Structured Frozen-Weight Skill Optimization for Audio Anti-Fraud Detection
task: Structured frozen-weight skill optimization for audio fraud detection
key_results: FRAUDSkill achieves 73.50% Macro-F1 on TeleAntiFraud, outperforming frozen baseline by 31.96%; reduces invalid outputs to 1.94% with validation-guided multi-path inference
comments: Elegant frozen-weight approach leaves audio-language model unchanged while optimizing external skills/policies, enabling rapid adaptation as fraud patterns evolve.

hypotheses.hypothesis: External skill optimization without model modification enables adaptable anti-fraud detection
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: FRAUDSkill achieves state-of-the-art while keeping backbone frozen

title: TeleAntiFraud 2.0: A Refreshable, Profile-Grounded, and Audio-Based Benchmark for Telecom Fraud Detection
task: Refreshable, profile-grounded, audio-based telecom fraud detection benchmark
key_results: TeleAntiFraud 2.0 freezes monthly evaluation sets with 900 calls (600 fraud, 300 near-domain non-fraud); perfect Macro-F1 drops to 0.65-0.68 with near-domain negatives; class-prior shortcuts and collapse observed
comments: Monthly frozen protocol and near-domain construction are valuable for realistic fraud detection; Mixed-Tree generation pipeline is practical and reproducible.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Near-domain negative examples are necessary to avoid class-prior shortcuts
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: perfect F1 on unrelated negatives drops to 0.65-0.68 with near-domain siblings

title: Calibrating Teacher--Student Discrepancy for On-Policy Distillation
task: Calibrating teacher-student discrepancy for on-policy distillation
key_results: Cal-OPD retains 52-65% of original teacher-student discrepancy while outperforming standard OPD; consistent improvements across model scales on mathematical reasoning benchmarks
comments: Principled approach to filter out teacher's own deviations from observed discrepancy; modest calibration overhead with meaningful gains in student reasoning.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Teacher self-deviation contaminates observed teacher-student discrepancy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: calibrating discrepancy outperforms standard OPD by filtering teacher artifacts

title: DeformSmith: Physics Harness-Guided Hierarchical Generation of Deformable Assets for Robot Manipulation
task: Physics-guided hierarchical generation of deformable assets for robot manipulation
key_results: DeformSmith generates assets with better visual quality and physical plausibility than PhysGen3D, PhysGM, PhysX-Omni; synthesizes data for robotic manipulation of deformable objects
comments: Clever agentic construction with physics harness closes the generation loop via robot interaction feedback; scalability to diverse deformable object categories worth exploring.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Physics-grounded harness and interaction feedback improve asset plausibility
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: iterative refinement via robot interaction produces physically credible assets

title: Refinement Is Inherently Editable: Training-Free Prompt-to-Prompt Image Editing with Generative Refinement Network
task: Training-free prompt-to-prompt image editing via generative refinement network
key_results: RefineEdit achieves best background-preservation scores in PSNR/LPIPS/MSE/SSIM on PIE-Bench; highest CLIP scores in edited region and whole-image; no external masks or training required
comments: Training-free approach with global refinement of binary codes is elegant; avoiding attention control simplifies deployment while maintaining effectiveness.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Global refinement of binary image codes enables accurate edit localization without spatial controls
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: coupled edit localization with content generation outperforms spatial mask approaches

title: MoME: Mixture-of-Memory Embeddings for Context-Aware Sparse Lookup
task: Context-aware sparse lookup for language models via mixture-of-memory embeddings
key_results: MoME improves over Value Embedding/Bigram/STEM baselines in iso-parameter and iso-training-FLOP settings; shows promising sub-billion-scale memory-size scaling; qualitative routing suggests semantic interpretability on polysemous tokens
comments: Context-aware gating over memory slots elegantly handles polysemy; semantic interpretability of routing is encouraging though hard to quantify.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mixture of memory slots handles polysemy better than single fixed entries
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: context-aware gating routes polysemous tokens to appropriate slots across languages

title: MLLMs Hallucinate when Information Distribution Drifts in Synergy Heads
task: Identifying and mitigating hallucinations in multimodal LLMs via synergy-head calibration
key_results: HEAL reduces hallucinations across multiple MLLMs; information distribution drift in synergy heads drives hallucination, not visual-only/language-only heads; dynamic calibration steering improves factuality
comments: Causal intervention and counterfactual analysis provides mechanistic insight into MLLM hallucinations; head-level interventions are practical and interpretable.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hallucinations stem from information distribution drift in synergy heads, not modality-specific heads
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: synergy-head calibration reduces hallucinations more than targeting other head types

title: Learning Foresight without Explicit Trajectories for 3D Diffusion Policies
task: Learning action foresight for 3D diffusion policies via movement trend guidance
key_results: Movement Trend Guidance improves DP3 by 6.7% on RoboTwin2.0 (62.8% vs 56.1%), 34.85% on LIBERO-40 (71.93% vs 37.08%), and 23% on real-robot tasks (72% vs 49%); adds only 3.52% parameters
comments: Compact latent representation of interaction evolution elegantly provides foresight without explicit planning; consistent improvements across simulation and real-robot tasks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Diffusion policies benefit from knowing interaction trajectory even without explicit plans
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: latent foresight conditioning substantially improves success across diverse tasks

title: Training-Adaptive Convolutional Sparse Coding via Information Bottleneck for Robust Visual Representation
task: Training-adaptive sparse coding with information-bottleneck perspective for robust visual representation
key_results: Adaptive CSC with differentiable sparsity coefficient improves clean-data recognition and robustness under perturbations on CIFAR/ImageNet; label-free post-training adjustment provides corruption robustness
comments: Information-bottleneck framing of sparsity trade-off is principled; adaptive coefficient learning addresses manual tuning problem elegantly.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Learnable sparsity coefficient controls information-compression trade-off better than manual tuning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: adaptive CSC improves both clean and corrupted-input performance

title: Retention-Constrained Post-Training Quantization of Cellpose-SAM for Stem Cell Microscopy
task: Quantization and deployment of Cellpose-SAM for stem cell microscopy with retention guarantees
key_results: W8A16 preserves instance F1 across all imaging modalities; mixed W4/W8 achieves 6.76x weight compression with no catastrophic failures; ternary quantization fails on 169/176 fields
comments: Stratified modality-specific retention criterion is appropriate for regulated medical imaging; retention-guided quantization provides auditable compression.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Modality-stratified retention is more informative than single-number accuracy for medical model compression
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: retention-criterion approach surfaces modality-specific failures hidden by aggregate metrics

title: Geometry of Values: Task Vector Composition for Ethical Preference Alignment in Language Models
task: Task vector composition for ethical preference alignment across languages
key_results: Fine-tuning and DPO remove bias in Llama-3.2 models (accuracy >98%); task vector orthogonalization isolates specific value preferences; cross-lingual evaluation reveals language-dependent biases (GPT-5-mini favors Honesty over Autonomy consistently)
comments: 12,000-instance dilemma dataset covering value conflicts and translations is valuable; orthogonalization method elegantly separates value vectors from instruction-following.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fine-tuning effectively removes first-option and language-specific biases in value reasoning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: fine-tuning and DPO boost accuracy to >98% on dilemma tasks

hypotheses.hypothesis: Task vector orthogonalization isolates value-specific directions from general instruction-following
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: orthogonalized vectors successfully transfer value preferences via arithmetic

title: Osteocyte necroptosis drives cortical bone resorption via osteocytic osteolysis in glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis
task: Establish whether glucocorticoid-induced osteocyte necroptosis mediates cortical bone loss in GIOP
key_results: Glucocorticoids activate STIM1-ORAI1-SOCE, promoting NFATc1-dependent mitophagy arrest, mtROS burst, and RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL necroptosis; SOCE/NFATc1 inhibition and osteocyte MLKL deletion preserved bone mechanical properties in mice
comments: The SOCE-NFATc1-mitophagy-mtROS axis identifies oxidative stress as a druggable vulnerability, though translating to clinical GIOP management requires pathway validation in human osteocytes.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Glucocorticoids trigger SOCE-dependent calcium dysregulation leading to osteocyte necroptosis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; SOCE inhibition and NFATc1 knockdown prevented necroptosis and cortical osteolysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: NFATc1 -mediated mitophagy arrest causes mtROS accumulation and RIPK-mediated necroptosis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; osteocyte MLKL deletion phenocopied protective effects

title: Combinatorial targeting of the miR-379/miR-410 cluster normalizes glucose and lipid homeostasis in male models of diabetes and obesity
task: Determine whether combinatorial inhibition of the miR-379/miR-410 cluster improves metabolic homeostasis in diabetes and obesity
key_results: Hepatocyte-specific decoy-mediated inhibition of miR-379/miR-410 cluster reduced triglycerides, total/LDL cholesterol, and basal glucose while improving glucose tolerance and insulin sensitivity; enhanced PI3K/mTOR signaling and mitochondrial function in type 1 and type 2 diabetic/obese male mice
comments: Multi-parameter metabolic improvements via a single cluster target are promising, though the study focuses on male mice and sex-specific effects require clarification given the stated preservation of effects irrespective of sex.

model_io.model: Hepatocyte-specific miR-379/miR-410 decoy in metabolic dysfunction models

hypotheses.hypothesis: Combined inhibition of miR-379/miR-410 cluster enhances PI3K/mTOR signaling to improve metabolic homeostasis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; decoy expression increased mitochondrial mass/function and improved glucose/lipid parameters

title: Structure of Blm10:13S proteasome intermediate reveals parallel assembly pathways for the proteasome core particle
task: Resolve the assembly mechanism of Blm10-bound proteasome core particles and identify parallel pathways
key_results: Cryo-EM structures of 5 CP intermediates reveal mutually exclusive interactions between Blm10 and Pba1/Pba2; no synergy between pathways; Blm10 affinity remains constant during maturation unlike Pba1/Pba2
comments: The parallel assembly pathway model elegantly explains how Blm10-CP proteasomes can be produced independently, but functional differences in degradation specificity between the two pathways warrant investigation.

model_io.model: Cryo-EM structural analysis of proteasome assembly intermediates

hypotheses.hypothesis: Blm10 and Pba1/Pba2 compete for binding to CP intermediates in mutually exclusive pathways
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; both lead to mature CP but through parallel assembly routes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Blm10 binding affinity is maintained during maturation unlike Pba1/Pba2, enabling persistent capping
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; affinity switch occurs only for Pba1/Pba2 chaperones

title: Tibial bone compression promotes recovery after brain injury through osteocyte PIEZO1
task: Establish whether bone mechanotransduction promotes brain recovery after traumatic brain injury
key_results: Tibial bone compression improved survival and motor/cognitive recovery in mouse and pig TBI models; PIEZO1 deletion in osteocytes reversed benefits; osteocytes secreted IL-1R2, APOL11a, HSP70 and increased serum BDNF, PF4, dopamine
comments: Novel bone-brain axis with mechanotransduction as a trigger; clinical applicability to non-weight-bearing limbs in immobilized patients is uncertain.

model_io.model: Dynamic compressive tibial axial loading (DCTAL) in TBI mice and pigs

hypotheses.hypothesis: Osteocyte PIEZO1 mechanosensing transduces tibial compression to neuroprotective factor secretion
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; PIEZO1 deletion abolished DCTAL benefits and serum factor-mediated protection

title: Long non-coding RNA H19 is overexpressed in azacitidine-resistant K562 cells but does not significantly alter drug sensitivity
task: Determine whether long non-coding RNA H19 drives azacitidine resistance in acute myeloid leukemia
key_results: H19 and miR-675 robustly upregulated in azacitidine-resistant K562 and HEL cells; H19 overexpression did not confer resistance and H19 knockdown did not restore sensitivity
comments: The finding that H19 is a biomarker of drug exposure rather than a resistance driver is important for avoiding misdirected therapeutic efforts, though limited functional validation in a single resistant model weakens conclusions.

model_io.model: K562 and HEL AML cell lines with azacitidine resistance selection

hypotheses.hypothesis: H19 upregulation drives azacitidine resistance in AML cells
hypotheses.result: Rejected; neither overexpression nor knockdown significantly altered drug response

hypotheses.hypothesis: H19 reflects epigenetic reprogramming during prolonged drug exposure rather than mediating resistance
hypotheses.result: Supported; H19 induction occurs in sensitive cells after extended exposure

title: Feedback between damaged epithelial and senescent fibroblast promotes pulmonary fibrosis
task: Identify the feedback circuit sustaining pulmonary fibrosis between epithelial and fibroblast cells
key_results: Sphingosine kinase 1 deletion or S1PR3 blockade reduces bleomycin-induced fibrosis; epithelial S1P→S1PR3→fibroblast senescence→IL-6→epithelial STAT3 forms self-amplifying loop
comments: The elegant reciprocal signaling axis provides multiple druggable nodes, though translation to human IPF patients remains to be demonstrated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Injured epithelium-derived S1P drives fibroblast senescence via S1PR3-PI3K-AKT-mTOR signaling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; pathway activation suppresses autophagy and drives senescence markers

hypotheses.hypothesis: Senescent fibroblast-derived IL-6 reactivates epithelial sphingosine kinase 1 via STAT3
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; closes self-amplifying feedback loop

title: GCN5-mediated H3K27cr regulates hair follicle stem cell migration and hair follicle development through KRT80 activation
task: Elucidate the role of histone crotonylation in hair follicle stem cell migration and development
key_results: GCN5-mediated H3K27cr enriched at KRT80 promoter and positively regulated its transcription; GCN5 alterations affected H3K27cr occupancy and KRT80 expression, influencing secondary hair follicle stem cell migration
comments: The GCN5-H3K27cr-KRT80 axis represents a novel crotonylation function in morphogenesis; mechanistic links between KRT80 and cell migration capacity require further validation.

model_io.model: Cashmere goat fetal hair follicle morphogenesis with CUT&RUN-seq

hypotheses.hypothesis: GCN5 catalyzes H3K27cr at the KRT80 promoter to regulate follicle stem cell migratory capacity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; GCN5 activity modulates H3K27cr occupancy and KRT80 expression in follicle stem cells

title: RamanOmics decodes the spatial vibrational–molecular architecture of senescence in aging and repair
task: Develop a multimodal framework linking biochemical and transcriptional senescence programs at single-cell resolution
key_results: RamanOmics integrates hyperspectral Raman imaging, snRNA-seq, and spatial transcriptomics to identify tissue-specific senescence programs (lung: extracellular matrix/TGF-β; skin: epidermal differentiation); conserved lipid-linked Raman signature (1,131–1,135 cm⁻¹) marks p21+ senescent cells; machine learning barcode enables in situ nondestructive senescence identification
comments: The multimodal integration is innovative and the conserved lipid signature is a notable discovery, though the functional significance of lipid accumulation in senescence and cross-tissue generalizability remain to be established.

model_io.model: Young and old mouse lung and skin with wound-healing model

hypotheses.hypothesis: Senescent cells across tissues share a conserved lipid-linked Raman signature enabling unified identification
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 1,131–1,135 cm⁻¹ lipid signature marks p21+ senescent cells with tissue-specific transcriptional programs

hypotheses.hypothesis: Wound-healing induces reactivation of epidermal differentiation genes alongside increased lipid signatures in senescent cells
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; RamanOmics revealed coordinated reactivation of Krt10, Lor, Sbsn in wound senescent cells

title: A longitudinal Health Atlas of age-associated multisystem physiology from population health examinations in China
task: Characterization of age-associated multisystem physiology and mortality prediction from longitudinal health examinations
key_results: Greater domain burden associated with mortality (HR 1.058 per SD); DynLifeNet predicts seven clinical abnormalities with macro AUROC 0.802; domain ranking preserved in independent cohort
comments: Large-scale real-world data (94M observations, 189K participants) provides robust aging signatures, but causality and mechanistic pathways require further validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Longitudinal physiological instability predicts mortality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; instability linked to mortality independent of cross-sectional metrics

hypotheses.hypothesis: Domain burden stratifies mortality risk
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; HR 1.058 per SD of mean absolute domain burden

title: SVPG: a pangenome-based structural variant detection approach and rapid augmentation of pangenome graphs with new samples
task: Structural variant detection and pangenome graph augmentation from long-read sequencing
key_results: SVPG outperforms state-of-the-art callers across sequencing technologies; tenfold acceleration of pangenome augmentation (vs traditional strategies); improved detection of rare and somatic SVs
comments: Leverages haplotype-resolved pangenome reference effectively; scalability to large multi-sample cohorts demonstrated, but clinical significance of rare SV detection requires validation.

model_io.model: SVPG structural variant detection and pangenome augmentation
inputs: Long-read sequencing data (multiple technologies and coverages)

hypotheses.hypothesis: SVPG leveraging pangenome reference improves SV detection accuracy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; superior performance vs state-of-the-art callers

hypotheses.hypothesis: Haplotype-aware augmentation accelerates pangenome construction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; tenfold speedup compared to traditional augmentation

title: A synergistic triple superior vortex human memory driven algorithm for head and neck cancer biomarker discovery
task: Feature selection for head and neck cancer biomarker discovery via metaheuristic optimization
key_results: SPHMO algorithm achieves 81.65–100% accuracy across 24 UCI datasets; 99.97% dimensionality reduction in RNA-seq data; outperforms classical and contemporary optimization algorithms on CEC2022/2017 benchmarks
comments: Impressive feature reduction efficiency, but head and neck cancer validation limited to biomarker discovery without independent clinical validation or mechanistic insights.

hypotheses.hypothesis: SPHMO superior point initialization and vortex perturbation enhance feature selection
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; exceptional accuracy and feature reduction across diverse datasets

title: Benchmarking large vision language models for multilingual image caption generation in low resource settings
task: Vision-language model evaluation for multilingual image captioning in low-resource languages (Urdu, Arabic)
key_results: Qwen2.5-VL with QLoRA fine-tuning achieves BLEU-4 48.5 (Urdu) and 50.1 (Arabic); QLoRA matches LoRA performance with reduced computational cost
comments: Addresses underrepresented language pair gap; translation-derived training data may introduce artifacts; human evaluation across multiple criteria adds rigor.

model_io.model: Vision-language models (Qwen2.5-VL, Pangea, PALO, mBLIP, PaliGemma2, LLaVA-OV, Florence-2, InstructBLIP, BLIP-2)
outputs: BLEU-4, ROUGE-L, METEOR, chrF, BERTScore, LASER, LaBSE scores

hypotheses.hypothesis: QLoRA fine-tuning achieves competitive performance to LoRA with lower computational cost
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; QLoRA yields best results (BLEU-4 48.5 Urdu, 50.1 Arabic) with reduced resources

title: A comparative study of vision transformer architectures evaluating MYC status prediction in diffuse large B cell lymphoma
task: Vision Transformer comparison for MYC rearrangement prediction in DLBCL from H&E images
key_results: Hierarchical ViT achieves highest accuracy; Swin Transformer offers best AUROC-speed trade-off (5.16 batches/s vs Hierarchical 1.78); multi-scale ViT architectures effective for patch-level MYC prediction
comments: Single-center, patch-level evaluation limits clinical utility; Grad-CAM does not confirm biological correctness of model focus; multicenter WSI validation essential before deployment.

model_io.model: Vision Transformer architectures (Basic ViT, T2T-ViT, CLIP-ViT, Swin, Hierarchical ViT)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-scale ViT architectures outperform single-scale models for MYC prediction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Hierarchical ViT achieves highest accuracy, Swin offers favorable speed-accuracy trade-off

title: Towards molecular-based functional classification of fetal bovine serum
task: Functional classification of fetal bovine serum batches via molecular profiling
key_results: Transcriptomic and cytokine profiling stratifies FBS batches better than CoA parameters; immune pathways show highest batch-to-batch variability across cell lines
comments: Addresses practical biomedical supply chain problem, but sample size and generalizability to other serum sources unclear.

inputs: mRNA from MRC-5, Jurkat, THP-1 cells cultured in different FBS batches
Cell culture media from FBS-treated cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: Geographical origin predicts FBS functional performance
hypotheses.result: Rejected; CoA parameters do not correlate consistently with cytokine secretion or gene expression

hypotheses.hypothesis: Immune-related pathways vary most across FBS batches
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; immune pathways show pronounced variability compared to other pathways

title: An empirical privacy risk assessment method for machine learning models towards GDPR’s “Data protection by design and by default” requirement
task: Empirical privacy risk assessment for machine learning models under GDPR compliance
key_results: Average detection accuracy of 89.3% for privacy risks; deep neural networks show higher privacy risk scores (µ=74.1) than ensemble methods (µ=51.6)
comments: Combines three attack vectors into unified 0–100 risk score; validation on only five benchmark datasets limits generalization to real-world systems.

inputs: Deep neural networks, decision trees, support vector machines
outputs: attack detection (model inversion, membership inference, attribute inference)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deep neural networks express higher privacy risk than ensemble methods
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; DNNs µ=74.1 vs ensemble µ=51.6

title: Prediction of tracheal intubation in patients with Pierre Robin sequence: development of a machine learning-based model
task: Machine learning prediction of difficult tracheal intubation in Pierre Robin sequence patients
key_results: XGBoost model achieves AUC 0.952 (derivation) and 0.943 (external validation); five-factor model identifies high-risk airway management episodes
comments: Strong external validation and clinically actionable threshold (84%), but relatively small validation cohort (n=87); decision curve analysis adds clinical utility.

inputs: Anatomical measurements: mandibular angle, tongue length, mouth opening, palatopharyngeal flow velocity, traction length

hypotheses.result: Confirmed; smaller mandibular angle, longer tongue, reduced mouth opening, higher flow velocity, greater traction length all increase risk

title: Altered expression of AMPK ULK1 PINK1 Parkin mitophagy-related genes and clinicopathological correlates in renal tissue from patients with diabetic nephropathy
task: Assessment of mitophagy-related gene expression in diabetic nephropathy renal tissue
key_results: PRKAA1, ULK1, PINK1, MAP1LC3B, BECN1 significantly downregulated in DN patients; PINK1 (AUC 0.762) and ULK1 (AUC 0.748) show highest discriminatory performance
comments: Limited sample size (n=33 DN, 33 controls) and lack of correlation with histopathological severity weaken clinical applicability; larger multicenter validation needed.

inputs: Kidney cortical biopsies from DN patients and controls
outputs: mRNA expression of AMPK/ULK1/PINK1/Parkin axis genes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mitophagy genes are downregulated in human DN tissue
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; AMPK/ULK1/PINK1/Parkin axis shows reduced expression

hypotheses.hypothesis: Gene expression correlates with renal function impairment
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; significant correlation with eGFR and creatinine

title: Preoperative ECG-based machine learning model for early prediction and risk stratification of postoperative delirium
task: ECG-based machine learning prediction of postoperative delirium risk
key_results: XGBoost model achieves AUC 0.97 (internal), 0.840 (external validation); 92% accuracy; HRV and inter-lead R-peak timing features most predictive
comments: Non-invasive, cost-effective biomarker with excellent internal validation and interpretable SHAP analysis; external validation cohort smaller and temporally distinct (2026).

hypotheses.hypothesis: Preoperative ECG features predict postoperative delirium risk
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; model achieves superior performance with AUC 0.97

hypotheses.hypothesis: HRV and inter-lead timing are major delirium predictors
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; SHAP analysis identifies these as top contributors

title: Single cell eQTL Mendelian randomization prioritizes FUBP1 as a candidate therapeutic target in T cells for lung cancer
task: Single-cell eQTL Mendelian randomization to identify immune-mediated lung cancer therapeutic targets
key_results: 21 putative causal genes across 13 immune cell types; FUBP1 in CD4+ naïve/memory T cells prioritized as tier-1 target; FUBP1 expression associated with CD4+ infiltration and lung cancer prognosis
comments: Integrates sc-eQTL, MR, and scRNA-seq for mechanistic prioritization; immune cell-specific effects highlight personalization, but functional validation and clinical trials needed.

inputs: Single-cell eQTL from 14 peripheral blood immune cell types

outputs: Ranked candidate targets (FUBP1 tier-1, MPZL3 tier-2, others tier-3)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Immune cell-specific causal genes exist for lung cancer susceptibility
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 13 of 21 genes show effects in single immune cell type only

hypotheses.hypothesis: FUBP1 in CD4+ T cells is a high-priority therapeutic target
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; tier-1 prioritization with functional associations to established lung cancer targets (EGFR)

title: Multidimensional immune subtyping reveals clinicogenetic molecular functional and pharmacologic heterogeneity in acute myeloid leukemia
task: Immune subtyping of acute myeloid leukemia for prognosis and drug response prediction
key_results: Five immune subtypes (IS1–IS5) identified from 1503 immune genes; IS4 most immune-engaged with higher PD-L1/HLA-DR and enhanced T-cell killing; TIME subtype improves prognostic discrimination over age/sex/ELN2017
comments: Comprehensive TIME characterization with functional and drug-screen validation; immune subtyping complements cytogenetics but requires prospective clinical trials.

outputs: Five immune subtypes with distinct clinical, molecular, immunologic features

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tumor immune microenvironment independently predicts AML outcome beyond cytogenetics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; TIME subtype improves prognostic fit and discrimination

hypotheses.hypothesis: IS4 shows enhanced immunogenicity and T-cell sensitivity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; IS4 displays higher immune markers and greater CD8+ T-cell activation vs IS1

title: Physician involvement and research quality in chest X-ray foundation models
task: Assessment of reporting practices and physician involvement in chest X-ray foundation models
key_results: Physician co-authorship associated with higher CLAIM adherence and more frequent fairness discussion; limited model sharing and increasing use of Transformers/LLMs
comments: Systematic review of methodological rigor in clinical AI; highlights publication bias toward incomplete artifact documentation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Physician co-authorship improves reporting standards in chest radiograph foundation models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; physician co-authorship correlated with higher CLAIM adherence and fairness discussion

title: Real-world mileage and survival of electric vehicles in Britain and implications for lifecycle emissions
task: Lifecycle emissions assessment of battery electric vehicles
key_results: Current BEVs: 88 g CO2e/km (54% reduction vs conventional vehicles at 254–270 g CO2e/km); first-generation BEVs driven less but still lower lifecycle emissions
comments: Real-world mileage data from all British EVs provides robust empirical grounding; transformer neural network improves on traditional assumptions about vehicle lifetime.

hypotheses.hypothesis: BEV lifecycle emissions lower than conventional vehicles despite shorter initial lifetimes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; BEVs showed lower lifecycle emissions even with reduced usage

title: Equitable supply in water distribution networks using data-driven optimization and AI-assisted voice automation
task: Data-driven scheduling for intermittent multi-village water supply
key_results: Flow measurements from 33/256 valve states (13%) produce schedule with <2.6% solver-predicted deviation; largest mean experimental deviation 5.55%; voice interface 97–98% entity-extraction accuracy
comments: Practical integrated framework (voice input, optimization, valve control) addresses real Global South water access challenges; limited data coverage (13%) requires validation on larger networks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Flow measurements from subset of valve states enable optimization without full hydraulic modeling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 13% state coverage yields <2.6% predicted deviation

title: Developing an epidemic-adjusted walkability index to analyze pandemic-resilient urban areas: a data driven GIS-based multi-criteria approach
task: Walkability index for pandemic-resilient urban areas
key_results: Inverse correlation between walkability and COVID-19 (r = −0.50 to −0.81); high street connectivity and land-use diversity associated with lower incidence
comments: Integrates spatial multi-criteria analysis with geographically weighted regression; epidemic-adjusted weighting adds health dimension to traditional walkability but causality not established.

inputs: 24 spatial indicators (accessibility, land use, sidewalks, connectivity, safety)

hypotheses.hypothesis: High street connectivity and diversified land use correlate with lower COVID-19 transmission
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by significant negative associations (r = −0.50 to −0.81)

title: Comparative study of metaheuristic optimised PI controllers for sensorless BLDC motor drives using nonlinear moving horizon estimation
task: Sensorless BLDC motor speed control via metaheuristic PI tuning
key_results: GWO-PI controller achieves lowest RMSE (0.6075 km/hr) vs PSO-PI (0.9538) and DEA-PI (0.639); NMHE estimates rotor position from electrical signals
comments: Comparative metaheuristic study systematic but limited to three optimization algorithms; GWO superior tuning justifies selection for EV applications.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Metaheuristic-tuned PI controllers outperform conventional PI under sensorless conditions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; GWO-PI RMSE 1.647→0.6075 km/hr vs conventional PI

title: Predictive multi-energy management and optimization of renewable-integrated smart buildings with coupled electrical–thermal loads and hybrid energy storage
task: Multi-energy optimization of renewable-integrated smart buildings
key_results: PGCN–BwKA achieves 98.4% system efficiency, 84.5% electricity cost reduction, 1.1$ operational cost, 0.4$/kWh LCOE, 42.6 ppm emissions
comments: Comprehensive prediction–optimization pipeline; progressive graph convolution captures spatial–temporal dependencies well but MATLAB simulation may not reflect real-world grid constraints.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spatial–temporal prediction via PGCN enables superior coordinated operation of heterogeneous energy systems
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 98.4% efficiency and 84.5% cost reduction vs baselines

title: A SHAP-interpretable LightGBM model for reliable IRI prediction: bridging data-driven analytics and mechanistic insight in urban pavement management
task: Interpretable LightGBM for pavement roughness (IRI) prediction
key_results: LightGBM achieves R²=0.83, MAPE=4.235%; air voids (Va) identified as strongest IRI predictor via SHAP
comments: Strong interpretability via SHAP; local Tehran dataset limits generalizability but supports context-specific pavement management.

inputs: 2313 road segments, 200m units (~462.6 km), pavement/material properties

hypotheses.hypothesis: Air voids is the dominant predictor of pavement roughness
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by SHAP analysis showing Va strongest effect

title: Quantum game-theoretic reinforcement learning for autonomous vehicle navigation and communication in vehicular networks
task: Quantum game-theoretic reinforcement learning for AV navigation
key_results: QGTRL improves path-planning accuracy by 18.7%, reduces communication latency by 15.3%, decreases energy consumption by 22.4% vs baselines
comments: Quantum-inspired classical computation avoids hardware requirements; game-theoretic coordination supports multi-agent scenarios but modest improvements and synthetic benchmarks limit practical impact assessment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Quantum-inspired policy encoding and game-theoretic coordination improve exploration and multi-agent convergence
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by 18.7% accuracy, 15.3% latency, 22.4% energy improvements

title: Decoupling and conditioning reshape influence allocation and the gradient-noise floor in multi-reward GRPO under a finite-sample U-statistic analysis
task: Multi-reward GRPO decoupling and conditioning analysis
key_results: Closed-form MSE law: (τ²/m)w^T·C·w + O(m^-2); decoupling allocates influence proportional to (Cw)_ℓ; aggregate reward difference non-significant but per-channel allocation significant (p<0.01)
comments: Rigorous finite-sample U-statistic theory with multi-tier validation (synthetic, GSM8K, fintech); notable caveat that decoupling reshapes influence without improving aggregate performance.

model_io.model: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with NA vs AN estimators

hypotheses.hypothesis: Decoupled normalize-then-aggregate (NA) reduces reward-correlation effects on gradient noise vs standard AN
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by MSE law showing influence free of channel std-devs; per-channel allocation differences significant

title: An interpretable machine learning framework for real-time copper cathode quality prediction in industrial bioleaching–solvent extraction–electrowinning operations
task: Real-time cathode quality prediction in bioleaching-solvent extraction-electrowinning
key_results: Decision tree achieves 97.08% accuracy, 94.62% precision/recall, F1=0.9461, AUC=0.965; key drivers: concentrate moisture (12.14%), acidity (8.37%), ORP (6.24%)
comments: High accuracy and interpretability suit industrial integration with PLCs; 343-day operational dataset provides robust validation but limited to single facility.

inputs: 15 key process parameters from bio-hydrometallurgical operations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Concentrate moisture, acidity, and ORP are primary drivers of cathode quality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; decision tree identifies these as top three predictors

title: Interpretable hybrid model combining CNN-ViT with Grad-CAM and SHAP for transparent mapping of land use changes
task: Multi-temporal LULC classification with interpretable deep learning
key_results: Overall accuracy 97.79% (κ=0.967) for 2013, 98.87% (κ=0.985) for 2024; CNN-ViT fusion with Grad-CAM and SHAP explanation
comments: High accuracy on arid-region LULC mapping is valuable; interpretability via Grad-CAM and SHAP strengthens transparency but adds computational overhead.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid deep learning architecture captures multi-scale and long-range dependencies better than single models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by 97.79–98.87% accuracy; temporal analysis reveals significant urbanization

title: Dynamic analysis, and offset boosting control of a new multi-echelon chaotic supply chain model with a sinusoidal nonlinearity for SDG-oriented resilient logistics
task: Dynamic analysis of multi-echelon chaotic supply chain model
key_results: NME-4D-CSCM exhibits chaotic attractors with higher sensitivity to initial conditions than prior models; equilibrium points unstable; offset boosting and rescaling control implemented
comments: Sinusoidal nonlinearity adds realism to supply chain dynamics; control strategies address practical concerns but evaluation is largely simulation-based.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sinusoidal nonlinearity increases system complexity and sensitivity compared to existing supply chain models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by larger maximum Lyapunov exponents and bifurcation analysis

title: Design and hardware performance of a LoRa-based vehicle tracking system with local data storage infrastructure
task: LoRa-based vehicle tracking with local data storage
key_results: Suburban path loss exponent n=4.63, urban n=3.43; reception ~3.2 km suburban (intermittent to 4.5 km), 1.0–1.5 km urban; packet delivery 85–90% suburban, 83.5±10.5% urban; TDMA sustains full delivery up to 97 nodes
comments: Comprehensive field characterization of standalone LoRa performance; energy consumption 4.44 J/msg is 70× higher than duty-cycled designs, limiting battery operation.

model_io.model: LoRa point-to-point tracking (Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 + NEO-6M GPS)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Beacon-synchronized TDMA supports higher node density than unsynchronized access
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; TDMA full delivery to 97 nodes vs <60% beyond 20 nodes unsynchronized

title: Improvement of personalized recommendation service level of intelligent libraries based on artificial intelligence and big data mining technology

key_results: SVD-LGCN achieves 4.1% relative improvement in NDCG@20 over LightGCN; Precision@5=0.413, Recall@50=0.589 on Book-Crossing dataset
comments: Dynamic user representation via SVD++ integration addresses data sparsity; practical validation on real library data strengthens claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynamic aggregation of historical interactions improves recommendation accuracy over static representations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by 4.1% NDCG@20 improvement

title: A multiscale energy polarization attention mechanism and H-shaped network for AI-driven biomimetic oceanic energy farms
task: AI-driven biomimetic oceanic energy farm control with hierarchical neural networks
key_results: Surrogate R²=0.98, RMSE=0.04; MAPPO controller: 53.7% energy production increase (15,100→23,200 MWh/year); fault prognostic F1=0.96 with 36h advance prediction; 40–60% efficiency gain vs conventional
comments: Comprehensive cyber-physical system integrating MEPAM filtering and H-shaped cross-domain network; simulation-only evaluation limits real-world deployment confidence.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multiscale energy polarization attention filters turbulent noise to improve vortex detection and farm control
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by 53.7% energy production increase and 40–60% efficiency gains

title: Assessing 3D shape cognition using BVH-based hierarchical geometric disclosure
task: 3D shape cognition assessment using hierarchical geometric disclosure
key_results: Recognition emerges at coarse-to-intermediate BVH levels; accuracy increases with geometric detail; higher confidence correlated with correct recognition
comments: BVH-based framework offers controlled stimulus generation; findings suggest hierarchical geometric structure fundamental to 3D recognition but small-scale user study limits generalizability.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Recognition thresholds occur at intermediate BVH disclosure levels
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; coarse-to-intermediate levels frequently triggered responses

title: Why responsible AI needs regional networks in low-resource health systems
task: Regional governance framework for equitable clinical AI in low-resource settings
key_results: Proposes primary-care-first approach with local governance, data sovereignty, and community infrastructure
comments: Policy-oriented perspective lacks empirical validation; framework emphasizes context-driven decision-making and privacy protection as foundational for equity.

title: Algorithmic systems, human agency and the future of platform research
task: Balanced perspective on algorithmic curation vs user agency in content consumption
key_results: Evidence linking algorithms to problematic outcomes inconclusive; users' own preferences play significant role alongside algorithmic mechanisms
comments: Calls for large-scale empirical research and experimentation; important corrective to algorithm-determinism but lacks specific hypotheses or novel measurements.

hypotheses.hypothesis: User self-selection accounts for a substantial portion of content diet patterns alongside algorithmic recommendation
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; literature review inconclusive on algorithm causality

title: Generation and stability of nanobubbles under microgravity conditions: unlocking a new horizon
task: Characterize nanobubble formation and stability under microgravity
key_results: Nanobubbles remain stable under microgravity with negligible concentration/size changes; direct generation under microgravity shows statistically significant concentration increase; gas-transfer performance (O₂, CO₂) validated across 0–1.8 g range
comments: Parabolic flight experiments provide limited microgravity duration; scaling to sustained orbital applications and long-term stability require further investigation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Gravity is not essential for nanobubble stabilization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; negligible changes under microgravity and increasing concentration under dynamic gravity

title: On the specificity of the tropospheric configurations related to stratospheric vortex decelerations
task: Identify tropospheric precursors to stratospheric polar vortex decelerations
key_results: Found no systematically distinct tropospheric configurations preceding or following vortex decelerations; majority of anomalous geopotential states at 10 hPa correspond to vortex decelerations but lack consistent tropospheric signatures
comments: The conclusion that vortex precursors are 'inherently nonspecific' suggests fundamental limits to predictability, though this negative result is valuable for constraining dynamical models.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Specific tropospheric patterns precede and follow stratospheric vortex decelerations
hypotheses.result: Rejected; diversity of responses indicates nonspecific, state-dependent coupling

title: Operando single-atom tracking in individual Pt nanoparticles detects the coexistence of Langmuir and Taylor active sites
task: Identify active site heterogeneity in Pt catalysts via operando atomic-resolution imaging
key_results: Quantitative 3-D operando TEM tracking reveals coexistence of Taylor- and Langmuir-like active sites in individual Pt nanoparticles; established direct correlation between coordinatively unsaturated surface atoms and catalytic activity across activation/deactivation cycles
comments: Atom-level tracking is technically impressive but limited to single particles; statistical inference to bulk catalyst behavior requires larger sample analysis.

model_io.model: Individual Pt nanoparticle during CO oxidation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Taylor and Langmuir active sites are distinct, immobile surface motifs
hypotheses.result: Rejected; sites coexist and dynamically interchange within the same nanoparticle during reaction

title: Synchronization of topological signals in higher-order adaptive multilayer network
task: Extend higher-order Kuramoto synchronization to adaptive multilayer networks
key_results: Higher coupling strength required for node-signal synchronization transitions in adaptive multilayer architectures; node dynamics incorporation delays link-signal synchronization onset
comments: The theoretical framework (annealed approximation for random layers and fully connected extension) validates simulations, though practical scalability to large realistic networks remains unaddressed.

model_io.model: Higher-order adaptive multilayer Kuramoto model on simplicial complexes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adaptive coupling between layers modulates synchronization thresholds
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; cross-dimensional interactions and same-dimensional coupling show distinct synchronization requirements

title: Hybrid non-Hermitian singularities and mapped-state concurrence in a superconducting-circuit dynamical matrix
task: Measure non-Hermitian spectral singularities in superconducting circuits
key_results: Identified exceptional points, exceptional lines, and diabolically degenerate exceptional points in the four-component Bogoliubov dynamical matrix; demonstrated spectrum reconstruction from cavity-field observables
comments: Bridges microscopic Hermitian bosonic dynamics to non-Hermitian effective descriptions with a practical measurement protocol, though the biological relevance of concurrence diagnostics remains unclear for circuit applications.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Effective Hermitian two-mode Hamiltonian yields non-Hermitian four-component Bogoliubov dynamics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; derived from microscopic circuit model via Heisenberg equations

title: Genetic landscape of an in vivo protein interactome
task: Mapping natural genetic variation to protein-protein interaction strength through QTL analysis
key_results: Identified piQTLs linking ~12,000 SNPs to 61 reporter PPIs; trans-piQTLs show stronger per-variant effects than cis-piQTLs and cluster near reporter proteins in network space; piQTLs overlap more with protein abundance QTLs than expression QTLs
comments: Elegant integration of PPI networks with genetics to uncover post-transcriptional regulation, though the 61 reporter PPIs represent a small fraction of the yeast interactome.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Genetic variants affect PPIs uniformly through cis and trans mechanisms
hypotheses.result: Rejected; trans-piQTLs dominate with stronger per-variant effects and cluster in network proximity

hypotheses.hypothesis: PPI variation is primarily expression-driven
hypotheses.result: Rejected; piQTLs correlate more strongly with protein abundance QTLs than expression QTLs

title: Social contagion drives collective consensus formation on scale-free networks
task: Understanding how scale-free network topology affects simple-to-complex contagion transitions in consensus formation
key_results: Scale-free networks can support complex contagion spread under certain conditions, contrary to previous findings; transition from simple to complex contagions depends on network topology and clustering
comments: The paper tests classical models (linear threshold, leader-follower) on synthetic networks, but validation on real social networks and empirical consensus data would strengthen claims about democratic applications.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Scale-free networks universally hinder complex contagions
hypotheses.result: Rejected; scale-free networks can support complex contagion under specific conditions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Network clustering affects contagion transition dynamics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; clustering properties modulate simple-to-complex contagion behavior
